author: Polar_Express
body:
Evocal / Para -

From the comments I see on my maps and the changes that have been suggested by map devs, I see that my maps do not belong on Avicus. Please do not consider them and please do remove any that you have accepted. I wont no part in the way maps are declined, as the dev feedback has no real backing other than opinion, and in some cases wrong and without any merit.

The map devs are preventing unique concepts from entering the walls game-mode. Everyone that has  submitted  maps are submitting very standard format maps / buildings structures like houses / huts / buildings with a standard mine below ( for the most part ) - and this is apparently what the map devs want. All map makers that are making maps are great, this is not to down play any map of submitted maps. This is directed at how the map devs are conforming all the maps to fit into a very specific format.  "The Cove " that has gotten awesome player feedback, was given a comment by the map dev to add an in-ground mine and huts all around the map and remove the tree. - We have 4-5 maps currently that have huts/houses and in ground mines don't we? This map has a large tree that actually has a mine in the branches, and is pretty much the focus of the map and what makes it unique. - so that map is not for the Avicus network as I am not going to change it.

Next - Diamond Vein - Again, Great reviews but too many diamonds make for poor game-play? Map Devs say this makes bad game play - yet a Nebula map has everyone in full diamond on one map and it it perfectly fine, but its not ok to make "even" diamond game-play on the walls? The map devs seem to want that on every walls quad only 1 person can get full or most diamonds and this makes for fun game-play? The one with the diamonds has a huge advantage, and while this is ok on some maps, why do you shoot a map down for making it where everyone can have the same level of gear? This is not a balance or game-play issue - no matter what the Map Devs think.

The bottom line is the map devs are really not helping add new unique content to the walls game-mode. This is being done without good cause because the game-play has not been tested, it has not been placed in a beta walls map server where people can try beta maps and see how it plays, its not had any official feed-back - yet "Game-Play"  is being used as a reason to add changes that really do not need to be made. In the cove - why would you say add huts and remove the tree, nothing logical about that, and it totally destroys the map idea. -1 for the map devs. Saying too many diamonds cause game play problems, no logic behind this, none, in any case logic would provide that if everyone has the opportunity to have the same weapons and armor then it would be have "Better" game play as it would be even. We have enough maps where only 1-2 people get all the stuff. The bottom line is that the map devs are shooting down great maps that could draw players back to the walls-game-mode. People are getting tired of the same cookie cutter maps, where you spend 10 min mining to only get enough stuff to die in the first 3 min after the walls drop. How many maps do you need to play that wash and repeat this same process over and over. Yea - some maps like this add variety, but come on.  Also, Look at time played for the map devs and see what game-mode they normally play, then look and see what game mode I play. I know what I am talking about. 


,

replies.body:
Sorry if you felt offended by any of the suggestions I brought (as I'm assuming you only intend to say this to me, as Para didn't do anything bad towards you). I'm gonna be honest and say I'm not a fan of The Walls gamemode and I have never really played it, however I have standard knowledge on which maps would or would not provide a good gameplay on it.

The amount of diamonds in Diamond Vein is too high, and as much as you want everything to be balanced (everyone having diamonds), I think it ruins the "mine and find your own resources" style of it. It's basically spawn, run and mine diamonds, wait 5 more minutes until the walls drop, fight... and that's it.
Other maps have chests with balanced stuff on it that you have to actually search and explore for.

The Cove is good. I just gave you some ideas that may/may not improve the gameplay style on it. Thought the huge tree could become a problem (as it goes past the walls...), but okay. I'm gonna give you the upper hand on this one. Keep it, and I'll test it and see how it plays.

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
This is not an attack, its a vent. I do not know what goes on behind the scenes so I sent it to the attention Evocal/Para. I never used a name or called out anyone in the post. Just used " Map Devs".

As for the Diamond Vein, there are over 30 chests on each side to provide balance and to eat up game play time. In no way does having 100000 diamonds on each map unbalance anything. The map is also very large running to the top of the diamond vein takes time. If anyone would have downloaded the map and played it and timed how long it takes to get the items , they would see it was longer than you may think. Also, if Time is a big problem that can be adjusted the time down. The whole point of the map was not to spend 10 min in the typical " Mine and find your own resources" style of play. The goal of the Diamond vein was get diamonds, enchant, hunt for hidden chest and fight. Not dig and hope your "luck" digging is better than the other guy.

As for the Cove Ty, but the tree should go to the edge of the walls, Jumping from the tree and ending outside of the quad should be prevented by the plugin. The tree does meet the walls . 

The bottom line of this post is that blanket statements about diamonds or game-play should be backed up with something that could help the map maker understand and corrent the problems, if the statement is just "opinion" that's fine, but people should have the ability to submit maps and have them accepted if the "Vision" is a little different than the map dev. as long as the quality of the map is on the level for a mass server such as Avicus, and the server is looking for new , unique content because no one is going to know how the game plays until after it is live.

Thanks for reading - no harm intended.

Maybe some of the staff that plays walls more often, like Ducksfanwaterloo, zeus449, PeachyYas, and itzdylan115, should have a test go on newly submitted maps.

I've downloaded some of the recent maps and I would like to play them on Avicus.

+1 for more maps in the walls rotation
